xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4278: Terminal permission prompts (incl. subagents) need an answerable dashboard dialog, and composer input must not be pasted into or lost around them

plan.title: Terminal permission prompts (incl. subagents) need an answerable dashboard dialog, and composer input must not be pasted into or lost around them
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The issue's four fixes share one parser (FR-1 feeds the dialog, the feed and the composer hold), one feed contract, and one docs section, and AC 4 asks for a single PR write-up; splitting would leave the hold without its parser and the docs without their subject. Files span only src/lib, src/dashboard and docs, with narrow per-item scopes.

narratives.Problem: A Claude Code permission prompt inside a dashboard conversation (including one raised by a background subagent) blocks work for hours with nothing answerable in the dashboard: the PermissionRequest hook only lights an icon, the pending-input feed never reports permission prompts, and the conversation pane-choice path reads tmux only. Separately, composer messages can vanish: the composer route discards deliverAgentMessage's result, so a Herdr refusal returns ok:true with no log line (conversation 20260927-3978, two sends at 15:24 UTC).
narratives.Proposal: Parse the prompt from the pane (authoritative) and enrich it with hook facts kept in an in-memory registry keyed by conversation and agent_id; expose pendingPermission on the conversation pending-input feed; answer it through a signature-checked keystroke route (arrows+Enter via resolveAgentPaneIo) that confirms by re-reading; show a TerminalPermissionDialog, a Needs you row with elapsed time and desktop notifications re-sent at 5 and 30 minutes. The composer route refuses to paste while a prompt is up (before ensure-main) and the browser holds and later resends the message with a fresh clientMessageId. The composer route checks the DeliveryResult, logs every outcome and returns 502 not-delivered, rendered as 'Not delivered — resend'. A probe root-causes the 15:24 loss and the PR documents it. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4278.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Answering terminal permission prompts for work/review/test agents (they keep the existing toast; follow-up issue)
- Non-Claude-Code harnesses (Codex approvals and pi ask modals keep their own paths)
- Persisting held messages across page reloads or adding a server-side message queue
- Changing Herdr's agent_prompt_stalled/timeout = delivered contract in herdr.ts
- Unifying src/lib/agent-input-detection.ts with the new permission parser
- Fixing the tmux-only read in claudeConversationPaneChoice beyond skipping it while a permission is pending
- Editing the separate overdeck-knowledge (OKF) repo
- Changing the Channels permission relay or ChannelPermissionDialog
- Sending digit keys or Escape to answer a permission prompt
- Switching Claude Code's agent selector view to reach a subagent's prompt
- Holding composer messages on a registry-only (not on-screen) permission entry

autoDecisions.summary: One plan with sizeJustification instead of sibling issues
autoDecisions.rationale: AC 4 asks for one PR write-up; the composer hold consumes the permission parser; the docs item covers both halves.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope is Claude Code conversations; agents keep the toast
autoDecisions.rationale: All evidence and the hook route are conversation-scoped; agents have Channels and a separate detector, so extending them would double the surface.

autoDecisions.summary: The pane is authoritative; the hook registry only enriches
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says never send keys unless the pane shows the expected prompt; the hook payload also lacks the reason text, which exists only on screen.

autoDecisions.summary: Answer with arrow keys + Enter; Deny selects the No row
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches buildChoiceKeystrokes' rationale (digit keys not guaranteed across versions) and avoids Escape side effects.

autoDecisions.summary: Client-side hold with server-side refusal (409 permission-pending)
autoDecisions.rationale: Overdeck stores no derivable state; the server never pastes into a prompt, and the browser already owns the optimistic bubble.

autoDecisions.summary: Released held messages and not-delivered resends use a fresh clientMessageId
autoDecisions.rationale: withConversationMessageReceipt caches every response per clientMessageId for 24h, so reusing the id would replay the refusal.
Ensure-main sends Down/Enter, which would move and confirm the permission menu.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs go to docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, not the OKF concept
autoDecisions.rationale: The OKF bundle is a separate repo outside this PR.

autoDecisions.summary: Registry is in memory per dashboard process
autoDecisions.rationale: Hook facts are transient; after a restart the pane still drives the dialog with an 'Unknown agent' label.

autoDecisions.summary: Hold only when the pane shows the prompt (answerable true)
autoDecisions.rationale: The registry is fed by a 1-second best-effort curl; a lost clear would otherwise block every send forever.

items.title: Parse Claude Code permission prompts from a pane screen, with captured fixtures

narrative.Action: PRD W1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4278.md). Create src/lib/agents/permission-prompt.ts exporting parsePermissionPrompt(paneText) and permissionKeystrokes(prompt, choice) with the exact API in the PRD. Build on parsePaneChoiceMenu(pane,{mode:'guard'}) from src/lib/pane-choice-menu.ts; accept 2 or 3 options (first /^yes\b/i, last /^no\b/i, middle matches the 'don't ask again' pattern); classify allow-once/allow-always/deny; extract header, detail lines, reason line, selectedIndex, signature. Keys = arrows from the cursor row to the target + Enter (never digits, never Escape). Capture fixtures permission-bash.txt, permission-dangerous-rm.txt, permission-subagent.txt from Claude Code 2.1.280 in a throwaway `tmux -L pan4278probe` server with a scratch cwd (implementation checkpoint; fallback: hand-written variant with a '# hand-written: <why>' first line). Never probe a live agent pane. Subagent checkpoint: if the subagent's prompt does NOT draw in the main view (only while that subagent's selector row is the filled-dot view), record that in the fixture header and in the PR; W3 then returns the registry-built answerable:false row for it, and switching views to answer stays out of scope — do not add view-switching keystrokes.

Given the agent-selector fixture or a PAN-3113 resume menu, parsePermissionPrompt returns null

narrative.Action: PRD W2. Create the in-memory registry module with recordPermissionRequest/clearPermissionRequest/listPermissionRequests/firstSeenAt/resetPermissionRegistryForTests. In routes/hooks.ts extract postPermissionEventRoute's body logic into exported handlePermissionEventBody(body, deps): agentKey = agent_id ?? 'main'; PermissionRequest records {toolName, toolInputPreview (Bash command / file_path / JSON, 200 chars), agentId, agentType, agentDescription from <subagentsDirFor(transcript_path)>/agent-<id>.meta.json .description, requestedAt}; CLEAR_ON events clear the same agentKey; waiting = registry still has entries for the conversation; log line adds agent=<key>. Async fs only.

narrative.Action: PRD W3. Create src/lib/overdeck/conversation-permission.ts with conversationPendingPermission(conv, deps) returning the PendingPermission shape in the PRD. Read the pane only via resolveAgentPaneIo(conv.tmuxSession).read(90) (Herdr and tmux; a read throw means no prompt). Prompt on pane => answerable row; registry entry but no prompt => answerable:false row from the oldest entry; label per PRD Decision 8; since = registry requestedAt else firstSeenAt. In conversation-reads.ts: compute it before the pane-choice check in getConversationsPendingInputFeed, skip claudeConversationPaneChoice when non-null, and let a row with only pendingPermission through; in getConversationRead push 'permissionRequest' into pendingInputKinds and return pendingPermission. Claude Code harness only. If the main view shows no prompt for a registered subagent (see the W1 subagent checkpoint), the registry-built answerable:false row still names the subagent.

narrative.Action: PRD W4. Add handleConversationPermissionAnswer(rawId, body, deps{io?, sleep?}) to conversation-permission.ts and the route beside POST /api/conversations/:id/pane-choice with the same validateOrigin guard. Sequence: validate choice/signature (400) -> resolve conversation (404/400 non-Claude) -> read+parse via resolveAgentPaneIo -> 409 prompt-gone / prompt-changed, 400 choice-not-offered -> send permissionKeystrokes with 60ms gaps -> sleep 700ms -> re-read; same signature => 409 delivery-unconfirmed; else {ok:true, answered}. Add the no-loss-matrix row from the PRD. Injected sleep in tests, no real timers.

Show TerminalPermissionDialog for conversation permission prompts

narrative.Action: PRD W5. New TerminalPermissionDialog mirroring ChannelPermissionDialog's props and overlay; rows Conversation, Agent, Tool, Command (<pre>), Reason (when present); buttons from options (Allow once / Allow always / Deny); non-answerable shows the 'not visible on the agent's screen' text and only Open terminal and Dismiss (Dismiss hides that signature/agent key for this browser session; it is the escape for a stale registry entry). Wire it in usePendingInputDialogs from the ['conv-ask-user-question'] rows (add pendingPermission to ConvAskUserQuestionRow), oldest since first; add respondToTerminalPermission in App/api.ts; mount in App.tsx beside ChannelPermissionDialog. After an answer keep 'Confirming…' until a later poll drops that signature; never hide optimistically; delivery-unconfirmed shows a toast. Follow the pan-style-guide skill.

Refuse composer pastes while a permission prompt is pending, before ensure-main

narrative.Action: PRD W8. As the first statement inside `if (harness === 'claude-code')` in handleConversationMessage — ABOVE the ensureMainInputTarget call — call deps.conversationPendingPermission ?? conversationPendingPermission; hold ONLY when the result has answerable === true (the pane shows the prompt). Then log the hold and return 409 {error:'Waiting: the agent needs a permission answer first', code:'permission-pending', deliveryUnknown:false, retryable:true}. A registry-only row (answerable false) never gates delivery: a dropped CLEAR_ON hook post could leave it stale and would block the composer forever. Ensure-main must never run while a prompt is up (its Down/Enter would answer the prompt).

items.title: Given a fixture pane showing a permission prompt, the composer route returns 409 with code permission-pending
Given a pane showing a permission prompt, the route calls neither ensureMainInputTarget nor deliverAgentMessage

Hold refused composer messages and resend them when the prompt clears

narrative.Action: PRD W9. MessageSendError gains code parsed from the response body; composerStore gains hold/releaseHeld and deliveryState 'held'; ComposerFooter calls hold on code permission-pending instead of onSendFailed; messageRows labels held bubbles 'Waiting: the agent needs a permission answer first' with Discard. New App-level useHeldMessageRelease resends held texts in order with a FRESH clientMessageId and no retry flag (receipts cache every response 24h — PRD Decision 6) once the feed has no row for that conversation, or a row without pendingPermission (the feed omits conversations with nothing pending); a second permission-pending re-holds.

The released resend sends a clientMessageId different from the original and no retry flag

narrative.Action: PRD W10. Capture deliverAgentMessage's DeliveryResult at both call sites (Kimi and default) in handleConversationMessage (make it injectable via deps.deliverAgentMessage). ok:false => console.warn '[conversations] <name>: not delivered via <path>: <failure>' and 502 {code:'not-delivered', deliveryUnknown:false, retryable:true}; ok:true => log '[conversations] <name>: delivered via <path>' (+ ' (deduplicated)'). Eaten-message watcher sets redelivered only when the redelivery returned ok:true and logs a failure line otherwise.

narrative.Action: PRD W12. In a throwaway Herdr session and scratch cwd (never the operator's panes), run a Claude Code pane with a background Agent and prompt it twice mid-turn through herdrBackend.prompt / deliverAgentMessage, recording raw RPC results. Candidates: (1) agent.prompt threw/refused (agent_blocked) -> ok:false swallowed; (2) agent_prompt_stalled/timeout reported delivered; (3) prompt-guard dropped -> ok:true deduplicated. Add a regression test that injects the reproduced result into deliverAgentMessage and asserts the composer-visible outcome. Fallback when Herdr cannot be driven headlessly: inject each candidate result and say so in the write-up.
